verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers DGX B200 hardware, management tools (BMC, Redfish, Docker/NVIDIA Container Toolkit), and marketing about AI platform performance, but contains no mention of an official SDK (e.g., CUDA, cuDNN, TensorRT, NIM) that an AI-native developer could build agents or applications against. Missing for 10: any documentation of a developer-facing SDK, API reference, or agentic tooling to build against.
